review.note: Retracted in M21, and the second-worst loss of the run after Batepá. On 16 June 1960 Portuguese troops fired on a crowd at Mueda, on the Makonde plateau, at the end of the long attempt to petition the administration rather than fight it; it is the standard opening episode of the Mozambican armed struggle. One edge can be argued from it, to the war of 1964, and only one: the atlas holds no Mozambican record before 1964 and none of FRELIMO’s founding, so there is nothing else here for it to reach.
